descriptionFull: The hooded crow ( Corvus cornix ) (also called hoodie ) is a Eurasian bird species in the Corvus genus. Widely distributed, it is also known locally as Scotch crow and Danish crow . In Ireland it is called caróg liath or grey crow , just as in the Slavic languages and in Danish. In German it is called "mist crow" ("Nebelkrähe").
